<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_EmployeeDevelopment" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/employee-development">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_EmployeeDevelopment" name="Employee Development and Promotion" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Roles">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IdentifyDevelopmentNeeds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TransitionToNewRole</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Promoted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DevelopmentParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_DevelopmentParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConsiderForPromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="HR">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FormalPerformanceReview</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FinalizePromotion</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_PromotionNotApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" name="Development need or career aspiration identified">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToIdentify</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_IdentifyDevelopmentNeeds" name="Identify development needs or career aspirations">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToIdentify</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IdentifyToPlan</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" name="Create personal development plan (training, mentorship, additional responsibilities)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IdentifyToPlan</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlanToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentParallelSplit" name="Start development activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlanToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToSkill</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement" name="Continue skill enhancement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToSkill</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SkillToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation" name="Provide feedback and evaluation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToFeedback</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FeedbackToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DevelopmentParallelJoin" name="Milestones reached">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SkillToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FeedbackToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToConsider</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToConsider</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConsiderToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FormalPerformanceReview" name="Conduct formal performance review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConsiderToReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewApproved" name="Review approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FinalizePromotion" name="Finalize promotion with new responsibilities and compensation adjustments">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalizeToTransition</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransitionToNewRole" name="Transition into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalizeToTransition</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TransitionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitioned into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TransitionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PromotionNotApproved" name="Promotion not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToIdentify" sourceRef="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" targetRef="Task_IdentifyDevelopmentNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyToPlan" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyDevelopmentNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanToSplit" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSkill" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToFeedback" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkillToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation" targetRef="Gateway_DevelopmentParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToConsider" sourceRef="Gateway_DevelopmentParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConsiderToReview" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" targetRef="Task_FormalPerformanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToGateway" sourceRef="Task_FormalPerformanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="Task_FinalizePromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="EndEvent_PromotionNotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalizeToTransition" sourceRef="Task_FinalizePromotion" targetRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TransitionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToContinue</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement" name="Continue skill enhancement">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToApproval" sourceRef="Task_FormalPerformanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="Task_AssignNewResponsibilities">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="EndEvent_PromotionNotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignToCompensation" sourceRef="Task_AssignNewResponsibilities" targetRef="Task_AdjustCompensation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompensationToTransition" sourceRef="Task_AdjustCompensation" targetRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TransitionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MilestonesReached</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReviewApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignNewResponsibilities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AdjustCompensation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" name="Development need or career aspiration identified">

    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" name="Create personal development plan (training, mentorship, additional responsibilities)">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlanToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SkillEnhancementMerge" name="Skill enhancement cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlanToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotReached</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MergeToContinue</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement" name="Continue skill enhancement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MergeToContinue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ContinueToFeedback</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation" name="Provide feedback and evaluation">

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MilestonesReached" name="Milestones reached?" default="Flow_NotReached">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reached</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" name="Consider employee for promotion or new role">

    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FormalPerformanceReview" name="Conduct formal performance review">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewApproved" name="Review approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignNewResponsibilities" name="Assign new responsibilities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssignToCompensation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AdjustCompensation" name="Adjust compensation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssignToCompensation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CompensationToTransition</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TransitionToNewRole" name="Transition into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CompensationToTransition</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TransitionToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Promoted" name="Employee promoted and transitioned into new role">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TransitionToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PromotionNotApproved" name="Promotion not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToIdentify" sourceRef="StartEvent_DevelopmentNeed" targetRef="Task_IdentifyDevelopmentNeeds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IdentifyToPlan" sourceRef="Task_IdentifyDevelopmentNeeds" targetRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlanToMerge" sourceRef="Task_CreateDevelopmentPlan" targetRef="Gateway_SkillEnhancementMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToContinue" sourceRef="Gateway_SkillEnhancementMerge" targetRef="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContinueToFeedback" sourceRef="Task_ContinueSkillEnhancement" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeedbackToMilestones" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedbackEvaluation" targetRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotReached" name="Not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Gateway_SkillEnhancementMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reached" name="Reached" sourceRef="Gateway_MilestonesReached" targetRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${milestonesReached}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConsiderToReview" sourceRef="Task_ConsiderForPromotion" targetRef="Task_FormalPerformanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToApproval" sourceRef="Task_FormalPerformanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="Task_AssignNewResponsibilities">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${approved}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewApproved" targetRef="EndEvent_PromotionNotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignToCompensation" sourceRef="Task_AssignNewResponsibilities" targetRef="Task_AdjustCompensation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompensationToTransition" sourceRef="Task_AdjustCompensation" targetRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TransitionToEnd" sourceRef="Task_TransitionToNewRole" targetRef="EndEvent_Promoted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that an activity continues to be carried out while feedback or evaluation is received, and that a later check decides whether the activity repeats or a further phase follows: Model the repeated activity as a loop. Place an exclusive merge gateway before the repeated activity, so that the entry flow and the return flow from the feedback step both join there. Put the feedback or evaluation step after the repeated activity, and place an exclusive decision gateway after the feedback step. One outgoing flow of that decision returns to the merge gateway for another pass, and the other leads to the next phase the description names, or to its own end event if the description says the process stops there. Do not run the activity once and then move on without a merge and decision gateway, and do not let the feedback step lead straight back into the activity.
rules.situation: the description states that an activity continues to be carried out while feedback or evaluation is received, and that a later check decides whether the activity repeats or a further phase follows

rules.instruction: When the description states that an assessment or review is performed by a party, and that its result decides whether a later step proceeds (for example, if the result is positive, the following step is carried out): Model the assessment itself as its own task, placed before the decision point and connected to the step that performs it. Follow it with an exclusive gateway on its outcome, with one branch continuing to the stated next step and the other leading to the stated negative outcome. The gateway must represent only the decision and must not replace the assessment task, and the assessment task must be kept even when the description does not name its result separately.
rules.situation: the description states that an assessment or review is performed by a party, and that its result decides whether a later step proceeds (for example, if the result is positive, the following step is carried out)

rules.instruction: When the description states that an ongoing activity continues while, once a checkpoint or milestone is reached, another activity is started, and the two are described as running at the same time with no order or choice between them: Model a parallel gateway at the point where the checkpoint is reached. Give it one outgoing branch for the continuing activity and one for the newly started activity, both unconditional. Do not place an exclusive gateway or a decision condition on these concurrent branches, and do not sequence the continuing activity after the new one.
rules.situation: the description states that an ongoing activity continues while, once a checkpoint or milestone is reached, another activity is started, and the two are described as running at the same time with no order or choice between them

rules.instruction: When the description joins two distinct actions within one clause with 'and', and presents each action as its own step or outcome: Model each action as a separate task, in the order the description states them, connected by sequence flows. Do not merge them into one task whose label combines the actions. If the clause ends the flow, let the end event represent the final outcome without absorbing the separate task.
rules.situation: the description states that a branch's outcome is completed through several distinct items joined by 'with' or 'and' inside one phrase (for example, the outcome is reached with one item and another item), and the generated model combines these items into a single task label

rules.instruction: When the description names several activities that must all be finished before a later activity can start, and it states no decision or order among them: Model the named activities as parallel branches opened by a parallel gateway, and join them with a parallel gateway before the later activity. Use an exclusive gateway only when the description states a choice between the activities.
rules.situation: the description states that after a decision or approval, two or more named actions are carried out together, joined by 'and' in one clause, with no order stated among them, and a later step follows once all of them are done

rules.instruction: When the description states that a review or evaluation is conducted and that a further activity (such as finalizing an outcome) follows only if the review is approved, with a separate outcome when it is not: Model the review as a task. Place an exclusive gateway after it. On the approved branch, model a task for the activity that carries out the approved outcome, and connect it onward to the later steps. On the not-approved branch, route directly to an end event that names that outcome. Do not place the finalizing activity before the decision or merge the two outcomes.
rules.situation: the description states that a review or evaluation is conducted and that a further activity (such as finalizing an outcome) follows only if the review is approved, with a separate outcome when it is not
